expected_local_metadata.title: Counterexamples to Satoh's SL(2) representation-filtration conjecture
expected_local_metadata.description: We give explicit counterexamples to the equality of the integral Andreadakis filtration A_n(k) and the SL(2,C) representation filtration D_n(k) formulated in Satoh's 2018 Oberwolfach report. D_n(k) acts on the whole quotient J/J^(k+1) in the rational algebra of individual matrix-entry functions. Elementary automorphisms lie in D_n(5) minus A_n(5) for every n>=4 and in D_n(6) minus A_n(6) for every n>=3, refuting the universal equality at every rank in the source's stated range. The proof uses a classical degree-five Lie identity, explicitly credited to Burde arXiv:1411.0950v2 equation(4) and Theorem4.14, with its Razmyslov attribution reported through that inspected source; the degree-six identity is a weighted substitution. No new PI identity or general PI method is claimed. Actual ideal-power containments and integral Magnus coefficients supply a self-contained proof. Independent exact polynomial and finite integer-matrix computations supplement it. Degree 5 at rank 3, every-degree failure, larger matrix sizes, trace algebras and the ordinary IA lower-central-series conjecture are not claimed. The bounded priority audit located no verified older complete application to this exact equality; historical firstness, exhaustive novelty clearance and continuously open status through 2026 remain uncertified. Complete final 2017/2021 Satoh journal texts and some related 2025/2026 journal texts were inaccessible; inspected public preprints, shorter sources and abstracts are distinguished in the archive. It preserves the unchanged original candidate and independent mathematical/priority reports, source-hash ledgers and verification code, without redistributing third-party full texts. AI tools were used extensively in development, verification, source investigation and writing. This is an unrefereed preprint without independent human peer review; internal AI reviews are not human peer review.
